info.title: Shortext API
info.description:
**Versioning**: every version is a frozen contract. A released version only receives additive changes
(new endpoints, new optional fields, new response fields); anything breaking ships in a new version.
Responses carry `X-Shortext-Api-Version`. When a version is scheduled for removal, responses also carry
`Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers; after the sunset date the version answers HTTP 410.
The list of versions and their status is available at `GET /api/versions`.

**Responses**: always HTTP 200. Check `success` and `code` (`1000` = success), see `ApiEnvelope`.
On failure, `trace_id` identifies the request for support.

disabled_reason.description: Set when disabled after failing for 3 days

WebhookEventPayload.description:
Body POSTed to your endpoint. Answer with a 2xx within 10 s and process asynchronously.
Failed deliveries are retried after 10 s, 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 12 h;
an endpoint failing for 3 days is disabled.
Delivery order is not guaranteed and an event may be delivered twice: dedupe on `id`.

**Signature**: `X-…-Signature: sha256=hex(hmac_sha256(secret, "{X-…-Timestamp}.{raw body}"))`.
Compare in constant time and reject timestamps older than 5 minutes.

bearerAuth.description: Company API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create it in the dashboard (Developer > API Keys) with the permissions the integration needs.
